issue: Stop() early-return (and OnProcessExited at :208) never Dispose()/null _process after wgturn-cli exits, so a crashed/exited process's handle is leaked; LaunchProcess (:188) then overwrites _process without disposing the prior instance — every crash->reconnect (or Dispose->Stop on an already-exited proc) leaks a Process handle until the GC finalizer, violating the project's own handle-safety standard.
fix: In the Stop early-return branch dispose+null _process like the main path does, and in OnProcessExited dispose+null _process (or route both through one ReleaseProcess helper); guard LaunchProcess to dispose any existing _process before assigning a new one.

issue: Binary replace is delete-then-move with no rollback: File.Delete(CliExePath) runs before File.Move(tempBin, CliExePath), and the finally deletes tempBin — if the move fails after the delete succeeds (AV scanning the temp, disk full, perm error), the user is left with no wgturn-cli at all and the temp is cleaned up, destroying the previously-working binary.
fix: Use File.Move(tempBin, CliExePath, overwrite: true) (atomic-ish, replaces in place) instead of delete-then-move, or move the old binary to a .bak and restore it if the move throws before deleting the backup.

issue: version.txt is written with the new tag unconditionally even though CopyDirectoryOverwrite (:353) silently skips locked files; if WinDivert64.sys/winws.exe was locked the install is partial (the exact new-winws+old-driver crash combo StopWinDivertService warns about) yet GetLocalVersion()/RemoteVersionChecker.IsNewer then report up-to-date, suppressing the retry that would repair the mismatch.
fix: Have CopyDirectoryOverwrite return whether any file was skipped and, when a skip occurs, either keep the old version.txt / write a partial-install marker or surface a FileSystem error so the stale-binary state is not masked as a successful update.
